The Ospreys, led by 11th-year head coach [[Matthew Driscoll (basketball)|Matthew Driscoll]], played their home games at the [[UNF Arena]] in [[Jacksonville, Florida]] as members of the [[Atlantic Sun Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 North Florida Ospreys men's basketball team|Ospreys]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 16–17 overall, 9–7 in ASUN play to finish in a tie for third place. In the [[2019 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]], they defeated [[2018–19 North Alabama Lions men's basketball team|North Alabama]] in the quarterfinals,{{Cite news|url=https://unfospreys.com/news/2019/3/4/mens-basketball-mbb-recap-vs-una-ast.aspx?path=mbball|title=Osprey Defense Deals North Alabama 76-66 Loss in ASUN Quarterfinals|work=University of North
